prompt: Implement the Chain of Responsibility pattern: each LevelHandler either handles a ticket within its severity limit or forwards it to the next handler, with "unresolved" when the chain runs out.
explanation: Each handler knows only two things: whether it can deal with the request, and who comes next. handle() therefore has three branches -- take it, delegate to next, or report that nobody could help -- and the recursion through next walks the chain automatically. Having setNext return the handler it was given lets a whole chain be wired up in one readable expression.
hints: setNext must assign this.next = next and return next, not this.
handle(): if severity <= limit answer yourself, else if next == null return "unresolved", else return next.handle(severity).
Build the default chain with bot.setNext(agent).setNext(manager) and return bot, the head -- routeAll should build a fresh chain for each severity.
